name: zopt_get_hud_type_for_current_hw_mode
description: zOpt::GetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode selects the software or hardware HUD type option based on g_zOpt_HwMode.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this option accessor remains part of the broader zOpt tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408360 validates testing g_zOpt_HwMode, returning *ZOPT_HUD_TYPE_HW when non-zero, and returning *ZOPT_HUD_TYPE_SW otherwise.
The native smoke verifies the software branch returns the SW HUD type value with g_zOpt_HwMode == 0 and the hardware branch returns the HW HUD type value with g_zOpt_HwMode != 0.
